title: The Gravity of the Deep
author: Beatrix Ravensworth
blurb: Elodie Iversen, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
